question:

The candidate regions below are normalized [x1, y1, x2, y2] in [0, 1] (origin top-left). At most one of them contains a building that was constructed or demolished between the two dates. Which region contains that change?
(A) [0.6708, 0.3726, 0.8308, 0.5326]
(B) [0.5910, 0.5968, 0.7510, 0.7568]
(C) [0.4138, 0.2619, 0.5738, 0.4219]
(D) No building change in any of the above regions.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
